title: [Cyrasei Lira'ka Meadery]
description: Hexagonal pine shelves line the walls in a honeycomb pattern, with some framing small windows overlooking the adjoining apiary.  Warm amber light filters through glass jars set within the windowed shelves, casting a soft glow across the worn, wooden floor.  Displayed among the other shelves are clay bottles of mead alongside candles, carved wooden dippers, and small pots of salve.  The scent of honey, vanilla, and almonds lingers in the air.
